verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a tax-filing service, but the evidence documents only a browser portal ('Kein Herunterladen und Installieren'), the MeinELSTER+ app, and third-party tax software that supports ELSTER. The ERiC developer channel is a building block for building integrations, not an official CLI, and its artifact host did not respond to the probe. No first-party command-line tool is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
